earliest_visible_sign.description: Small, light-coloured or translucent circular spots, may look water-soaked when young.
earliest_visible_sign.location_on_plant: older leaves, often along leaf margins and veins

characteristic_sign_or_lesion.description: Round to oval lesions with a tan or cream centre and a distinct dark ring around the centre, creating an eye-like appearance.

colors.color_progression: translucent or light-coloured spots to tan/cream centres with a distinct red-brown to black ring

shape.shape_progression: circular or oval early, becoming shot-hole after centre collapse, or irregular after coalescence

size.size_variation_note: Lesions may be most numerous along leaf margins and near veins

texture_and_surface.other_surface_details: The centre can fall out, leaving a shot-hole appearance

border_and_margin.margin_type: distinct red-brown, dark-brown, purple, or black ring around the centre

advanced_or_severe_stage.description: Lesions darken and become necrotic, centres fall out leaving shot-holes, leaves yellow and die.
advanced_or_severe_stage.coalescence: Many lesions may merge into larger dead areas.
advanced_or_severe_stage.tissue_death_appearance: Leaves yellow, dry, and die at infection sites, premature leaf drying.
advanced_or_severe_stage.percentage_affected_tissue_note: Can reduce grain filling when infection is early and severe.

distribution_on_plant.horizontal_pattern: often along leaf margins and veins
distribution_on_plant.other_parts_if_severe: leaf sheaths, husk leaves covering ears, and ear indirectly through husk shrivelling

pathognomonic_features: Round to oval eye-like lesions (1-4 mm) with a tan centre, surrounded by a distinct dark ring (red-brown/purple/black) and a narrow yellow halo.
Centre of the lesion falling out to leave a shot-hole appearance.
